skills.name: Wine
skills.text: Dong Zhuo can use any spade card in his hand as Wine.

skills.name: Garden of Lust
skills.text: Whenever Dong Zhuo attacks or is attacked by a female, the target must use an additional Escape to avoid damage.

skills.name: Collapse
skills.text: At the end of Dong Zhuo's turn, if he has more health than any other character, he must either lose one health or reduce his maximum health limit by one.

skills.name: Violent Tyrant
skills.text: King Ability: When another character deals damage to a player, they may allow Dong Zhuo to flip a judgment card. If it is a spade, Dong Zhuo heals one health.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
